flow.say_vi: The quickest and most efficient method to generate his Outro is to use his Skill twice alongside his Ultimate and sequence of Basic Attacks. Due to his Skill having a long cooldown of 10 seconds at S0, longer than any rotation he would want to employ itself, it is best to weave in his skill into rotation of your other support characters to refresh its cooldown, thus allowing you to use it again for his main Concerto rotation.
